scope: Phase 10B public pointer.move and pointer.click physical validation on macOS using a test-owned AppKit receiver fixture

semantics.pointerMove: MOVED with verified=true only after current Quartz pointer location is independently re-observed at requested coordinates
semantics.pointerClick: CLICK_POSTED after verified positioning; buttonDelivery=POSTED; semanticConsequenceVerified=false

fixture.target: fixture center on current primary display

resultPolicy.BLOCKED: The macOS/Swift/Accessibility environment or test-owned fixture cannot be established before public pointer behavior can be evaluated.
resultPolicy.FAIL: Public runtime/SDK behavior, pointer position postcondition, left/right delivery oracle, or required restoration does not match the contract.
resultPolicy.PASS: Public move is position-verified, both public click calls retain delivery-only semantics, the independent AppKit fixture receives exactly one left and one right down/up pair, no user content is clicked, and the pointer is restored.

nextStepOnPass: Promote pointer.move and pointer.click to PHYSICALLY_VALIDATED on the current macOS reference surface, record dedicated evidence, then begin Phase 10C drag discovery without exposing held-button state across RPC calls.
nextStepOnBlockedOrFail: Preserve immutable evidence, diagnose forward, and do not promote Phase 10B.
